description: Read-only XRPL raw ledger-state lookup for a ledger. Omit `ledger_index` to use the default ledger, or provide a ledger index/selector to pin the lookup; use `limit` to cap the number of ledger-state objects returned and pass `marker` from a previous response to continue pagination. The result returns raw canonical ledger-state entries without modifying the ledger; large state queries should be paginated, and calls are subject to the configured gateway rate limits. Use this for canonical ledger-state objects; use n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger for ledger headers and transaction-list metadata instead.

ledger_index.description: Optional ledger index or selector identifying the ledger whose state objects should be returned.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

limit.description: Optional maximum number of ledger-state objects to return.
limit.title: Limit

marker.description: Pagination marker returned by a previous response.
marker.title: Marker

name: n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger_data
